docs.title: Hello, World!
docs.text:
Welcome to the blog. This is the first post — a placeholder to confirm everything is wired up correctly.

MkDocs with the Material theme and the blog plugin makes it easy to write posts in Markdown and deploy them automatically to GitHub Pages. Posts live in docs/blog/posts/, are sorted by date, and grouped into categories and an archive automatically.

More content coming soon.
